name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
description: Take over San Andreas together. CoopAndreas puts several players in the same game: they walk, drive, fight and explore the same world, with a server that keeps everyone in step. An early alpha.

setup.detail: Cairn has not found the game. The mod needs Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas version 1.0 US: use Locate game and pick gta_sa.exe.

setup.title: Proxy ready
setup.detail: Rename the game's own eax.dll to eax_orig.dll before the mod is installed: the mod puts its own eax.dll in its place and the game still loads the original through it.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it in the game's folder.

hostSteps: Make sure the game is version 1.0 US, rename its eax.dll to eax_orig.dll, then download the mod above.
Start the server: run CoopAndreas\server.exe from the game's folder and leave it open. It listens on port 6767 (open it for friends).
Press Play. The mod's own launcher opens and asks for its free beta serial key: follow its instructions (the key is made for your PC), then press Launch CoopAndreas.
In the game press Start Game, enter a nickname and your server's address (127.0.0.1 on the same PC) and port 6767.
joinSteps: Make sure the game is version 1.0 US, rename its eax.dll to eax_orig.dll, then download the mod above, the same version as the host's.
Press Play and enter the mod's free beta serial key in its launcher when it asks, then press Launch CoopAndreas.
In the game press Start Game, enter a nickname and the host's address and port 6767.

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: One player runs the server, everyone connects to it by address. Everyone needs the same version of the mod.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod in the game's folder and updates it when a new version is released.

items.name: On foot and in vehicles
items.detail: Walking, fighting, weapons, vehicles and passengers are shared between players.

items.name: Missions and pickups
items.detail: Mission markers are shared; pickups and some mission features are still being worked on.
